# Progix Digital

> Progix Digital is a digital marketing, web development and AI automation agency serving clients worldwide. Tagline: "We Build. We Grow. We Automate." The team has 10+ years of experience and has delivered 1,200+ projects across 37+ industries.

Contact: inquiries@progixdigital.com
